source: John Snow, On the Mode of Communication of Cholera, 2nd ed., 1855: Table VIII (population and deaths by sub-district) as the left table and Table XII (the company supplying each sub-district) as the right. Read from the example-1855-cholera-south-london checkout, not retyped.

declaredParameters.semantics: Each left row takes the single value its key has in the right table's bring column, which becomes an additional KEY column. The row count is unchanged -- nothing is added and nothing is multiplied. A left key the right table has no row for is reported by name and its rows are DROPPED, because a row with no category cannot be grouped by that category. A right table holding two different bring values for one key is REFUSED outright; it is not resolved to the first, the last, or any of them.
declaredParameters.matching: Exact equality after trimming. No case folding, no punctuation folding, no resemblance.
declaredParameters.equivalentTo: A pandas left merge on `on`, restricted to one brought column, followed by dropping the unmatched rows -- EXCEPT for the ambiguous case, where a merge multiplies rows and this refuses.
